faq.a1: Stars are earned by completing tasks set by your parent. Each finished step gives you the stars shown next to it.
faq.q2: 🏆 What can I redeem my stars for?
faq.a2: You can redeem your stars for rewards set up by your parent. These could be screen time, treats, privileges, or other special rewards.
faq.q3: 👨‍👩‍👧 How does the parent dashboard work?
faq.a3: Parents can add kids, create tasks, give bonuses or penalties and see everyone's progress in one place. The dashboard is protected with a parent access code.
faq.a4: Yes! Open the Kids Area to see your stars and tasks, and the Leaderboard to see who is on top this challenge.
faq.a5: We take privacy seriously. Your information is encrypted and secured. Please review our Privacy Policy for more details.
faq.a6: StarBo is available on iOS and Android devices. Log in with the same account to see your family on every device.
faq.q7: 🆘 I forgot my PIN. What do I do?
faq.a7: A parent can change your PIN from the Parent Dashboard (Reset PIN) or the Parent Profile screen. Parents can reset their own password from the login screen.
faq.q8: 💔 How do I delete my account?
faq.a8: Open Parent Area → tap the profile icon at the top → Parent Profile → Delete Account. This removes your account and all your family's data.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to your questions
faq.still_help_msg: If you couldn't find your answer, contact our support team — we're always happy to help.

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Making parenting and personal growth fun
about.mission_body: StarBo was created with a simple mission: to make parenting easier and help children develop good habits in a fun, engaging way. We believe that motivation through positive reinforcement creates lasting behavioral change.
about.vision_body: We envision a world where families connect through shared goals and celebrate achievements together. We want to empower parents with tools to guide their children and help kids understand the value of hard work and persistence.
about.v1_text: Your family's privacy and safety are our top priority.
about.v2_text: We design everything with families in mind.
about.v3_text: Learning should be enjoyable for everyone.
about.v4_text: We believe in continuous improvement and learning.
about.f1_text: Simple interface designed for kids and parents
about.f2_text: Your data is encrypted and protected
about.f3_text: Full control over tasks, rewards, and progress
about.touch_body: Have suggestions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you!
about.thanks: Thank you for being part of the StarBo family! 💚

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.subtitle: We're here to help — choose your preferred way to reach us.
contact.faq_body: Before reaching out, check our FAQ for quick answers to common questions.
contact.response_body: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours during business days. Thanks for your patience!

privacy.s1_body:
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as:
• Account information (email, password, name)
• Child information (name, age, PIN)
• Task and reward data
• Usage analytics
privacy.s2_body:
We use your information to:
• Provide and improve our services
• Enable parent-child communication
• Send important notifications
• Maintain security
• Comply with legal obligations
privacy.s3_body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All sensitive information is encrypted both in transit and at rest.
privacy.s4_body: Parents are responsible for obtaining appropriate consent for children under 13. By using StarBo with a child, you represent that you have the authority to provide such consent.
privacy.s5_body: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. Parents can request deletion of their child’s information at any time.
privacy.s6_body: We use secure cloud services from Google to handle sign-in and store your data. Google may process this information as described in its privacy policy.
privacy.s7_body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
privacy.s8_body:
You have the right to:
• Access your personal data
• Correct inaccurate data
• Request deletion of data
• Export your data
privacy.s9_body: Parents can manage privacy settings and control what information is shared. Check your account settings for available options.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.contact_body: For privacy concerns, reach out through our active channels:

terms.s2_body: StarBo is designed for children with parental supervision. Parents are responsible for ensuring their children's usage complies with these terms.
terms.s3_body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Parents must ensure their PIN/password is kept secure.
